Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.ledger

Class KfeUserStatementEntity

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.ledger.KfeUserStatementEntity
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.data.domain.Persistable<UUID>
@Entity public class KfeUserStatementEntity extends Object implements org.springframework.data.domain.Persistable<UUID>
Persists a user's display-ready transaction statement for the short statement-history window.

The row associates one user with one transaction, optionally records the wallet context, stores a presentation payload, and carries an expiry time. Its fixed creation-order key is kept separately from refresh timestamps so status updates do not reorder statement history. The Persistable state flag lets Spring Data distinguish a first insert from an update even though this entity assigns its UUID before persistence.
